claim_safe_interpretation: Minimal homogeneous W_tau(a) slightly improves chi-square but loses under AIC; this is evidence against the minimal proxy, not against the multi-channel framework.
KiDS COSEBIs gives a structured low-tail endpoint signal, while validation remains blocked by tomographic and physical-promotion caveats.
The restricted observer/path basis survives its immediate controls, but remains a narrow permission-only diagnostic rather than population validation.
DESI shape/time-readout is positive against frozen controls, but the margin is very small and row-sensitive.
The narrow W_time uncertainty basis improves the baseline but fails controls; this is a route diagnostic, not positive evidence.
The current redshift/scale-factor void-web proxy is model-selection negative; it argues for source-native void/web observables before validation.
The centered sky-z observer variant improves the baseline but fails control resistance; it constrains rather than validates the observer/path channel.
